name: Measurement problem

subjectOf.text: The classical law of supply and demand fails because supply and demand curves cannot be measured independently and because economic interactions are intrinsically probabilistic rather than continuous and deterministic.
subjectOf.abstract: such as the impossibility of measuring supply or demand curves independently, the intrinsically probabilistic nature of economic interactions
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Quantum Economy and Tokenomics (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4900878
scope_conditions: applies to the continuity and determinism assumptions of classical supply and demand

subjectOf.text: Reputation based governance allocates decision power by past contribution and community standing, which promotes transparency and trust, but reputation is difficult to measure objectively.
subjectOf.abstract: This model allocates decision-making power based on participants' past contributions and reputation within the community, promoting transparency and trust but challenging to measure objectively.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, DAO Market Meta Analysis 2024 (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5254152
scope_conditions: DAOs allocating voting power by contribution history, community feedback, or peer review
